environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on AWS ECS behind an Application Load Balancer with CloudFront distribution in front. CloudFront origin request policy forwards X-Forwarded-Host but the distribution has a custom Lambda@Edge viewer-response function (arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789:function:sri-inject-v3) that post-processes HTML responses. This function parses any <script> tags in the response body and appends integrity='sha384-...' attributes computed against a pinned manifest stored in a DynamoDB table (table: sri-manifest-prod, partition key: script-url). If a script src does not match any entry in the manifest, the Lambda@Edge function replaces the entire <script> tag with a comment <!-- blocked: unverified script -->. The function also injects a Content-Security-Policy header with require-sri-for directive and script-src restricted to cdn.example.com with hash sources matching the manifest entries. The DynamoDB manifest is updated only via a CodePipeline triggered by the CDN team's approved releases.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, ALB, CloudFront distribution

lambda_edge.behavior: Injects SRI integrity attributes from DynamoDB manifest, strips unverified script tags, adds CSP with require-sri-for

dynamodb_manifest.update_mechanism: CodePipeline from CDN team approved releases only
dynamodb_manifest.entries: sha384 hashes for all approved cdn.example.com scripts
